issues.issue: Did the RPD unreasonably reassess the old identity evidence under s.109(2) after new evidence was admitted?
issues.applicant_position: RPD reassessed the old identity evidence under s.109(2) after new evidence was admitted, contrary to Wahab and Bafakih.
issues.respondent_position: RPD properly applied s.109(2): it did not reassess identity but checked whether any untainted evidence supported the decision.
issues.result_quote: I am satisfied that the RPD erred when it reassessed the old evidence as part of its analysis under subsection 109(2) of the Act.
